summary: Read-only SEO verification on preview build. All per-page Helmet-injected SEO tags (title/description/canonical/og:url/og:title/og:description) are unique (count=1) and match the expected values exactly for the 10 public pages. Legal pages (mentions-legales, cgv, politique-confidentialite, politique-cookies) each have their own title containing 'Repair & Co' and correct canonical. /rgpd correctly redirects to /politique-confidentialite. /admin has exactly ONE robots meta with 'noindex, nofollow'; all other public pages have 'index, follow'. Home JSON-LD Organization matches expected fields (name, legalName, url, logo, email, telephone) byte-for-byte. /magasins renders exactly 9 LocalBusiness JSON-LD blocks (+ 1 BreadcrumbList) — for every store: image, url prefix, telephone (+33, no spaces, no leading 0), addressCountry=FR, priceRange=€€, dayOfWeek Mon–Sat, and opens/closes match spec (lattes/montpellier-nord/montpellier-sud/nimes-costieres 09:30-20:00, nimes-etoile/beziers 09:30-19:30, boulogne/plaisir/les-ulis 10:00-20:00). /faq FAQPage JSON-LD has 12 Question entries with proper @type/name/acceptedAnswer.@type/text. Static assets /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /manifest.json, /og-image.jpg all return HTTP 200; manifest.json contains name/short_name/theme_color=#1A5C3A/icons for /icon-192.png and /icon-512.png. No occurrence of 'edouardmourinpro@gmail.com' anywhere in rendered pages; legal pages expose 'contact@repair-and-co.fr' as expected. index.html static: lang=fr, exact <title>, theme-color #1A5C3A, og:type=website, og:locale=fr_FR, og:site_name, twitter:card=summary_large_image, favicon icon, apple-touch-icon, manifest link — all present. As noted in the brief, description/canonical/og:url/og:title/og:description/twitter:*/og:image/robots are intentionally NOT in static index.html and are injected per-page — verified.
